g.text: Shake flasks: power per liquid volume
20% nominal fill | 37 °C | separate curves for nominal flask sizes
Baffled screening power has no explicit flask-diameter or orbit term; size trends reflect working fill.
Generic estimated flask geometries; screening estimates are not measured product performance.
Dashed lines: calibration required or extrapolated. Red rings: extrapolated values. Missing estimates are gaps.
Vertical axes: log scales. Coincident baffled curves across orbits reflect the screening equation, not measured equivalence.
